Solve \(a^3+23\equiv0\pmod{24}\), so \(a^3\equiv1\pmod{24}\).

Modulo \(8\): odd residues satisfy \(a^3\equiv a\pmod8\), so \(a\equiv1\pmod8\).

Modulo \(3\): \(a^3\equiv a\pmod3\), so \(a\equiv1\pmod3\).

Thus \(a\equiv1\pmod{24}\). Positive values less than \(100\) are:
\[
1,25,49,73,97
\]
So there are \(\boxed{5}\).
